detailed.description: Points-based permanent residency for skilled workers worldwide. Candidates create an online profile and enter the Express Entry pool. IRCC issues Invitations to Apply (ITAs) in regular draws.

English or French proficiency (CLB 7 for NOC 0/A, CLB 5 for NOC B)
Must have worked legally in Canada

Work experience 1 year in last 3 for NOC 0/A/B
Education (NOC C/D: Canadian high school equivalent)

detailed.description: For entrepreneurs with innovative business ideas supported by a designated Canadian organization (VC fund, angel investor, or business incubator).

detailed.description: For foreign nationals with job offer as home child care provider. Pathway to PR after 24 months of work experience.
requirements: Full-time job offer as child care provider in Canada

Endorsed by Australian organisation or prominent person

Job offer with salary EUR 45,300+ (general) or EUR 41,041+ (shortage occupations)

Demonstrate exceptional talent or exceptional promise

requirements: Employment contract with Brazilian company OR technical assistance agreement

2-year renewable visa for remote workers. Income from outside Brazil. Exempt from Brazilian income tax on foreign earnings.
For persons with regular income from abroad (pension, investments, remote work). Renewable annually. Path to permanent residency.
For investors making qualifying investments in Argentina. Growing tech sector especially Buenos Aires startup scene.
requirements: Investment in Argentine company or property

detailed.description: For workers, students, and investors. Annual renewable. Can apply for permanent residency after 1 year.
requirements: Employment contract OR investment in Chile OR educational enrollment

requirements: Monthly income USD 1,000+ OR property ownership

detailed.description: 2-year visa for remote workers. Income from non-Ecuadorian sources. No income tax on foreign earnings. Galapagos, Amazon access.
requirements: Remote work proof for non-Ecuadorian employer

detailed.description: For workers and investors in Bolivia. Growing lithium and tech sectors. Very affordable cost of living.

For workers, investors, and retirees. Multiple categories. 1-3 year validity. Significant path to permanent residency.
requirements: Employment contract with Colombian company OR investment certificate OR pension proof

detailed.description: For workers, investors, and students. Up to 183 days, renewable. Peru's economy growing with mining, services, and tourism.
requirements: Employment contract OR investment OR educational enrollment

detailed.description: For workers with job offer from Mexican company. Growing tech sector especially Monterrey, Guadalajara, and Mexico City.
Employer-sponsored work permit for foreign professionals. Limited sectors. Government controls most employment.

detailed.description: For foreign workers with Dominican Republic employer. Tourism, free trade zones, and tech sectors active.

For foreign nationals employed by Guatemalan companies. Ministry of Labour issues permits. Growing call centre, textile, and agriculture export sectors.

requirements: Investment proof (USD 1,000+ in El Salvador) OR property purchase

detailed.description: For foreign nationals with employment contract in Honduras. Tourism, textile manufacturing, and agriculture sectors.
For workers and investors. Most Central American country offering affordable residency. Growing agricultural exports.
For retirees (USD 1,000/month pension) or rentistas (USD 2,500/month income). Tax exemptions on imports and foreign income. Excellent healthcare.
One of world's most popular retirement visas. USD 1,000/month pension required. Extensive discounts on services, health, transport, hotels, restaurants.
requirements: Proof of pension from government or private company

For 18-30 year olds (35 for some countries) from partner countries. Up to 12 months (23 months for UK/Canada). Can extend with 3 months specified work.

For foreign workers in Solomon Islands. Tourism, fishing, and forestry sectors. Very small labour market.
For foreign workers in Vanuatu. Zero income tax makes it attractive. Vanuatu Citizenship by Investment programme available separately.

requirements: Investment USD 130,000+ in Vanuatu Development Support Programme

For foreign workers in Samoa. Tourism, fishing, and agriculture. Very small labour market.
For foreign workers in Tonga. Tourism and remittances major income sources. Small labour market.
For foreign workers in Maldives. Tourism sector dominant — resort employees are almost all expatriates.

detailed.description: For foreign nationals employed in Seychelles. Tourism, financial services, and fishing sectors. Very expensive cost of living.
For foreign workers in Cape Verde. Tourism, renewable energy, and fishing sectors. Growing digital nomad hub.
Cape Verde actively courts digital nomads with visa-free entry for many nationalities and low cost of living.
Visa on arrival for most nationalities. Very small tourism industry. Indian Ocean island nation.

For foreign workers in Timor-Leste (East Timor). Oil and gas sector opportunities. Young nation established in 2002.

detailed.description: For foreign workers in Brunei. Oil and gas sector dominant. Very low taxes. Employer sponsorship required.
